notes.title: Zombie Shooter: Ares Virus is on sale!
notes.notes:
Hello dear players，

Our game [b]Zombie Shooter: Ares Virus[/b] is finally here. It is a doomsday survival game, in which you will pick up your weapons to fight against the zombies that are rushing towards you. Come experience this zombie shooting game and survive the massive zombies!

[b]If you like it, don't forget to recommend it to those around you![/b]
